messages:
ciara: We're ~2 weeks out from DP kickoff. Need to lock scope granularity + gating criteria for pilot customers. Quick sync?

mike: Yes. High-level asks from sales/dev: onboarding friction metric, rollback SLA, and explicit data-consent. Propose short acceptance criteria: onboarding <=3 steps, core flow passes for 90% of sample prompts, no PII persisted in logs.

jen: Agree. Also we should define feedback cadence: weekly 15-min async survey + end-of-pilot ~30–45m interview. Can we require 3 success stories per partner?

sam: Risk callout — some partners will demand private deployment during pilot. Recommend treating private-ready as a stretch goal, not a mandatory gate.

ciara: :thumbsup: on stretch. For gating I like staged gates: Alpha = core flow functional, Beta = 1-month SLA + monitoring, GA = 10+ customers or X revenue. Thoughts?

mike: Alpha checklist (short): config profile v1, 1 synthetic load run, prompt-set pass >=85%. I'll drop a concise checklist. Code snippet for acceptance checks:
```
- onboarding_steps <= 3
- prompt_pass_pct >= 85
- latency_p95_ms <= 200
```

jen: I'll draft the outreach + consent script to set participant expectations (runbooks, data usage, time commitment ~2 hrs/wk, compensation). Need legal to sign off on consent wording.

pm-bot: Reminder: export pilot metrics dashboard and retention cohort by 1748100000.

sam: Also add a 'rollback playbook' item: automatic fallback to hosted model variant + notify partner + postmortem within 48h.

ciara: Good. Negotiation tactic: offer a 30-day dedicated capacity trial for top 3 partners in exchange for weekly feedback sessions and access to evaluation prompts.

mike: Targets: 8 partners total, aim to have 4 commitments in next 2 weeks. Outreach owner: jen.

jen: Got it — I'll post the outreach template in #product-marketing and start recruitment today. I'll also collect an initial prompt set from each partner to validate early.

ciara: Action items recap: jen — outreach + consent draft + prompt intake; mike — alpha checklist + perf targets; sam — rollback playbook + private-ready notes; ciara — partner SLA matrix + trial comps. Sync: Tue 10:00am.

pm-bot: Meeting created: Tue 10:00 — invitation sent to participants.
